retire.subject: company
retire.name: transfer_pricing_applies_to_related_parties
retire.quote: Yes. Transfer pricing rules apply to UAE businesses that have transactions with Related Parties and Connected Persons, irrespective of whether the Related Parties or Connected Persons are located in the UAE mainland, a Free Zone or in a foreign jurisdiction.
retire.note: Records transfer-pricing coverage, not a complete general anti-abuse rule.

retained_primary.subject: company
retained_primary.name: transfer_pricing_applies_to_related_parties
retained_primary.quote:
1. In determining the Taxable Income, transactions and arrangements between Related 
Parties shall meet the arm's length standard as specified in Clauses 2, 3, 4 and 5 of this 
Article and any conditions that may be prescribed in a decision issued by the Authority. 

Federal Decree-Law of 2022 On Corporate and Business Tax
retained_primary.note: Related-party transactions/arrangements must satisfy the Article 34 arm’s-length standard and prescribed conditions/methods. This parameter does not certify every connected-person deduction condition; payments to Connected Persons have additional rules in Article 36.

retire.subject: company
retire.name: residence_test
retire.quote: UAE CT applies to juridical persons incorporated in the UAE and juridical persons effectively managed and controlled in the UAE, as well as to foreign juridical persons that have a permanent establishment
retire.note: Official FAQ scope statement; the quote is limited before the source's parenthetical cross-reference.

retained_primary.subject: company
retained_primary.name: residence_test
retained_primary.quote:
3. A Resident Person is any of the following Persons: 
a. A juridical person that is incorporated, established or otherwise recognized under the 
applicable legislation of the State, including a Free Zone Person. 

Federal Decree-Law of 2022 On Corporate and Business Tax 
 
 
 
b. A juridical person that is incorporated, established or otherwise recognized under the 
applicable legislation of a foreign jurisdiction and is effectively managed and 
controlled in the State. 
c. A natural person who conducts a Business or Business Activity in the State. 
d. Any other Person as may be determined in a resolution issued by the Cabinet at the 
suggestion of the Minister.
retained_primary.note: Corporate-tax Resident Person status under Article 11(3)(a)-(b): UAE incorporation/establishment/recognition (including Free Zone Persons), or a foreign juridical person effectively managed and controlled in the UAE. This is not the separate natural-person domestic residence-days test. Article 69 governs first tax periods; treaty effects must be assessed separately.

retire.subject: individual
retire.name: global_income_taxable
retire.quote: Four major types of individual income consisting of global income, retirement income, capital gains and timber income are all taxable.
retire.note: The NTS FAQ describes the stated individual income categories as taxable for a foreigner resident for the entire year.

retained_primary.subject: individual
retained_primary.name: global_income_taxable
retained_primary.quote:

1. 종합소득

2. 퇴직소득

3. 양도소득
retained_primary.note: Current primary Article 4 categories: comprehensive income (interest, dividends, business, employment, pensions and other income), retirement income and capital gains, subject to applicable exemptions/special rules. The archived FAQ separate timber-income category is not retained as current classification. This is not a claim every receipt is taxable or every category uses one progressive table. 2026-11-18: removed PDF page-header metadata from quote; substantive wording unchanged.

retire.subject: individual
retire.name: worldwide_income_reportable
retire.quote: If you are a Korean resident, you have to report your income from all sources, both inside and outside Korea.
retire.note: Applies to a Korean resident as stated by the NTS; no rule is inferred for a non-resident.

retained_primary.subject: individual
retained_primary.name: worldwide_income_reportable
retained_primary.quote:
제3조(과세소득의 범위) ① 거주자에게는 이 법에서 규정하는 모든 소득에 대해서 과세한다. 다만, 해당 과세기간 종료
일 10년 전부터 국내에 주소나 거소를 둔 기간의 합계가 5년 이하인 외국인 거주자에게는 과세대상 소득 중 국외에
서 발생한 소득의 경우 국내에서 지급되거나 국내로 송금된 소득에 대해서만 과세한다.
retained_primary.note: General resident-income tax scope, qualified by Article 3(1): a foreign-national resident whose aggregate Korean domicile/residence period is no more than five years during the ten years preceding the end of the tax period is taxed on foreign-source income only when paid in or remitted to Korea. Korean-source income and other conditions remain separately applicable. The old unrestricted English FAQ is not current authority.

retire.subject: individual
retire.name: residence_years_min
retire.quote: Principally, a resident is any individual who has his/her domicile in Korea or a place of residence for 1 year or more in Korea.
retire.note: One-year threshold applies to a place of residence; the alternative domicile test is preserved in the cited source.

retained_primary.subject: individual
retained_primary.name: individual_days_threshold
retained_primary.quote:
제1조의2(정의) ① 이 법에서 사용하는 용어의 뜻은 다음과 같다. <개정 2010. 12. 27., 2014. 12. 23., 2018. 12. 31.>
1. “거주자”란 국내에 주소를 두거나 183일 이상의 거소(居所)를 둔 개인을 말한다.
2. “비거주자”란 거주자가 아닌 개인을 말한다.
3. “내국법인”이란 「법인세법」 제2조제1호에 따른 내국법인을 말한다.
4. “외국법인”이란 「법인세법」 제2조제3호에 따른 외국법인을 말한다.
5. “사업자”란 사업소득이 있는 거주자를 말한다.
② 제1항에 따른 주소ㆍ거소와 거주자ㆍ비거주자의 구분은 대통령령으로 정한다.
[본조신설 2009. 12. 31.]
retained_primary.note: Current primary Article 1-2(1)(1): Korean domicile OR a place of residence for at least 183 days. Domicile, counting/deeming rules under the Enforcement Decree and treaty effects require separate assessment. Replaces the obsolete undated FAQ one-year parameter; no unsupported historical effective dates are invented. Reviewed against the 1 July 2026 consolidation; not a claim that the 183-day rule began in 2026.
